description: Université de Liège: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Université de Liège. Coverage: Université de Liège. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Gouttelette sur une fibre de sucre; Sur l'utilisation du séquençage à haut débit pour l'étude de la divers; Analyse à haut débit des modèles de polarons de type Fröhlich. Formats seen: CSV, DWCA. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
